title: El banco
goal: Open an account with documents you do not have
culture: Nobody has all of it on the first visit and the list on the wall is longer than the real one. Ask for the real one out loud, write it down, and come back without irritation: getting cross at a ventanilla has never moved a document forward.

beats.en: I want to open an account.
beats.good: Simple to say. As it turns out, not simple to do.

beats.es: ¿Trae cédula, constancia salarial y recibo de luz?
beats.objective: Say you have not got them
beats.good: No tengo, plainly, without apologising for it. Nobody has all of it the first time and he knows that better than you do.

beats.es: Hm. Sin eso no se puede.
beats.en: And what exactly do I need?
beats.good: Ask for it out loud and write it down. It will be shorter than the list on the wall, and it is the one that counts.

beats.es: Con eso ya le abrimos la cuenta.
beats.good: Vuelvo mañana, without irritation. Getting cross at a window has never once moved a piece of paper forward in this country.
